description: This file defines the SystemInfo class and related functions for retrieving system information such as memory, CPU load, and environment variables within the WPEFramework project. It also declares external C functions and metadata related to the module.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: A singleton class providing access to system information such as memory, CPU load, hostname, and environment variables, with methods to update and retrieve this data.

classes.name: SystemInfo::MemorySnapshot
classes.description: A nested class within SystemInfo that captures a snapshot of memory and swap statistics, and can output its data as a JSON string.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Generates a device ID based on raw device data and a key length.

methods.name: GetEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: SetEnvironment
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable, with an option to force the change.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SystemInfo.

methods.name: SetTime
methods.description: Sets the system time.

methods.name: SetTimeZone
methods.description: Sets the system time zone.

methods.name: GetHostName
methods.description: Returns the hostname of the system.

methods.name: GetTotalRam
methods.description: Returns the total RAM in bytes.

methods.name: GetPageSize
methods.description: Returns the system's memory page size.

methods.name: GetPhysicalPageCount
methods.description: Calculates the number of physical memory pages.

methods.name: GetUpTime
methods.description: Returns the system uptime in seconds.

methods.name: GetFreeRam
methods.description: Returns the amount of free RAM in bytes.

methods.name: GetTotalSwap
methods.description: Returns total swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetFreeSwap
methods.description: Returns free swap space in bytes.

methods.name: GetCpuLoad
methods.description: Returns the current CPU load.

methods.name: GetCpuLoadAvg
methods.description: Returns the CPU load averages.

methods.name: TakeMemorySnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of current memory and swap statistics.

methods.name: AsJSON
methods.description: Outputs the memory snapshot as a JSON string.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Returns total memory in bytes.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns free memory in bytes.

methods.name: Available
methods.description: Returns available memory in bytes.

methods.name: Cached
methods.description: Returns cached memory in bytes.

methods.name: SwapTotal
methods.description: Returns total swap in bytes.

methods.name: SwapFree
methods.description: Returns free swap in bytes.

methods.name: SwapCached
methods.description: Returns cached swap in bytes.

methods.name: Ticks
methods.description: Returns a high-resolution timestamp in microseconds.

methods.name: Architecture
methods.description: Returns the system architecture string.

methods.name: Chipset
methods.description: Returns the chipset information.

methods.name: FirmwareVersion
methods.description: Returns the firmware version.
